page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.hfg7 family. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance features 32 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 32 vCPUs. It is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. Cache specifications include 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 33 MB of L3 cache.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent data. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The hardware supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX, AVX-512 Foundation, AVX-512 Vector Neural Network Instructions (VNNI), and AVX-512 Brain Floating Point 16-bit (BF16), though it lacks Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX).

Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the average performance tier across multiple tests. It achieves a Geekbench multi-core score of 11417.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 31330.51. In database operations, the instance registers 12087.98 operations on Passmark and handles 30.49 million Redis SET operations per second. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1856.24 GB/sec, which drops to 111.56 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. These characteristics make the instance suitable for general-purpose workloads, software compilation, static web serving, and database operations that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
